secrets.name: GROQ_API_KEY
secrets.description: Groq API key for AI caption/hashtag/hook generation. Obtain from https://console.groq.com/keys.

secrets.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
secrets.description: Google Gemini API key for AI features (fallback to Groq). Obtain from https://aistudio.google.com/apikey.

secrets.name: TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN
secrets.description: Telegram bot token for the central admin/moderation bot. Obtain from @BotFather.

secrets.name: TELEGRAM_ADMIN_CHAT_ID
secrets.description: Numeric Telegram chat/user ID of the platform owner for admin authorization. Obtain from @userinfobot.

secrets.name: LIVEKIT_URL
secrets.description: LiveKit server URL (wss://...) for real-time live streaming. Obtain from LiveKit dashboard.

secrets.name: LIVEKIT_API_KEY
secrets.description: LiveKit API key for generating access tokens. Obtain from LiveKit dashboard.

secrets.name: LIVEKIT_API_SECRET
secrets.description: LiveKit API secret for generating access tokens. Obtain from LiveKit dashboard.

secrets.name: RESEND_API_KEY
secrets.description: Resend API key for sending email verification links on signup. Obtain from https://resend.com/api-keys.
